Bash(cd D:/work/games/xingjitafang
# 从 strings.xml 提取键值对转为 .properties 格式
# 使用 awk 解析 XML
awk '
/<string name=/ {
    # 提取 name 属性
    match\($0, /name="\([^"]+\)"/, name_arr\)
    name = name_arr[1]
    # 提取标签内容
    gsub\(/.*>/, "", $0\)
    gsub\(/<\\/string>.*/, "", $0\)
    value = $0
    # 转义 properties 中的特殊字符
    gsub\(/=/, "\\\\=", value\)
    gsub\(/:/, "\\\\:", value\)
    gsub\(/!/, "\\\\!", value\)
    # 去除首尾空白
    gsub\(/^[ \\t]+/, "", value\)
    gsub\(/[ \\t]+$/, "", value\)
    if \(name != "" && value != ""\) {
        print name "=" value
    }
}
' app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml > assets/i18n/strings_zh.properties

# 检查转换结果
echo "转换结果行数:"
wc -l assets/i18n/strings_zh.properties
echo "前5行示例:"
head -5 assets/i18n/strings_zh.properties)

Bash(cd D:/work/games/xingjitafang
# 使用 sed 和 grep 提取 strings.xml
grep '<string name=' app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml | while IFS= read -r line; do
  # 提取 name
  name=$\(echo "$line" | sed 's/.*name="\\\([^"]*\\\)".*/\\1/'\)
  # 提取值
  value=$\(echo "$line" | sed 's/.*>\\\(.*\\\)<\\/string>.*/\\1/'\)
  if [ -n "$name" ] && [ -n "$value" ]; then
    echo "${name}=${value}"
  fi
done > assets/i18n/strings_zh.properties

echo "转换结果行数:"
wc -l assets/i18n/strings_zh.properties
echo "前5行:"
head -5 assets/i18n/strings_zh.properties)
